g.text: Size effects on activity-heading memory depend on input regime
Second-half windows: chemicals16000–32000, Spring1600–3200. First half discarded; stationarity is not assumed.
Every displayed condition:12 independent seeds. Whiskers:95% whole-seed percentile intervals (2000 paired resamples).
Direction requires both endpoint R≥0.1; usable coverage retains all available lag pairs. Multiple regions require frame contrast≥10% of basal; low contrast is below that threshold.
Positive mean and fluctuation amplitude scale together. Native laws/clocks differ. Activity heading is not cell migration; size effects do not isolate physical site motion from geometry.
Read with the native histories and full temporal/window/organization supplements. Spring sampled run-duration inference is excluded from the accepted primary scope.
